title: Efficacy of Ramelteon on Speeding Up Sleep in Subjects With Delayed Sleep Phase Syndrome

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to evaluate the ability of ramelteon, once daily (QD), to advance the timing of sleep in individuals with delayed sleep phase syndrome.

Posted outcomes: Latency to Persistent Sleep Over a 2-night Average Measured by Polysomnography (Nights 6-7). timeframe=Nights 6-7. Ramelteon 1 mg QD=59.30 (±6.684); Ramelteon 4 mg QD=39.40 (±6.352); Ramelteon 8 mg QD=55.94 (±6.482). p=0.646
